english.title: Possess / control a false / improperly obtained / another persons identity document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse had in your possession or under your control

(A)_[an identity document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that was false]_
(B)_[an identity document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that was improperly obtained]_
(C)_[an identity document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that related to someone else, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(D)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY THE APPARATUS..), which to your knowledge was or had been specially designed or adapted to be used for the making of false identity documents]_
(E)_[an article or material, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE OR MATERIAL..) which to your knowledge was or had been specially designed or adapted to be used in the making of false identity documents]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6 of the Identity Documents Act 2010.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Bod â meddiant / rheoli dogfen adnabod anwir / person arall / a gafwyd mewn ffordd amhriodol
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) heb esgus rhesymol, roedd gennych yn eich meddiant neu dan eich rheolaeth

(A)_[ddogfen adnabod, sef **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), a oedd yn anwir]_
(B)_[ddogfen adnabod, sef **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), a gafwyd mewn ffordd amhriodol]_
(C)_[ddogfen adnabod, sef **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), a oedd yn gysylltiedig â rhywun arall, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(D)_[gyfarpar, sef **(..SPECIFY THE APPARATUS..), a oedd neu a ddyluniwyd neu a addaswyd, hyd y gwyddech chi, i'w defnyddio i wneud dogfennau adnabod anwir]_
(E)_[eitem neu ddeunydd, sef **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE OR MATERIAL..) a oedd neu a ddyluniwyd neu a addaswyd, hyd y gwyddech chi, i'w defnyddio i wneud dogfennau adnabod anwir]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i Adran 6 Deddf Dogfennau Adnabods 2010.

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant - constable - PACE
Arrest without warrant - examining officer other than constable - paragraph 6 of Schedule 8 to the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014
other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictable: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.


Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

Notes
(i) In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
(ii) On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
